shortDescription.text: Ingreslock / Bindshell Unauthenticated Root Shell on TCP Port 1524

fullDescription.text: TCP port 1524 (ingreslock) exposes an unauthenticated interactive root shell (/bin/sh). Note: rsh/bindshell probes against port 1524 interact with this same underlying root bind shell and have been consolidated into this single compromise record.

help.text:
Immediate: Immediately terminate the `/bin/sh` bind shell listening on TCP port 1524 (`fuser -k 1524/tcp`), comment out the `ingreslock` line in `/etc/inetd.conf` or `/etc/xinetd.d/`, and reload `inetd`.
Short-Term: Block TCP port 1524 at the host firewall (`ufw deny 1524/tcp` / `iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 1524 -j DROP`) and audit `/etc/inetd.conf` for unauthorized backdoor listeners (`rsh`, `rexec`, `rlogin`).
Verification: Run `nmap -sV -p 1524 192.168.195.139` and confirm port 1524 returns `closed` or `filtered` with no shell prompt.

shortDescription.text: PostgreSQL 8.3.1 Default Superuser Authentication (postgres:postgres)

fullDescription.text: PostgreSQL 8.3.1 on TCP port 5432 accepts default superuser credentials ('postgres:postgres'), allowing remote database enumeration and catalog read access.

help.text:
Immediate: Change the `msfadmin` account password immediately (`passwd msfadmin`) and revoke FTP access for administrative users via `/etc/ftpusers`.
Short-Term: Disable cleartext FTP authentication altogether in `/etc/vsftpd.conf` (`local_enable=NO` or enforce TLS via `ssl_enable=YES`).

shortDescription.text: SSH Default Credential Shell Access (msfadmin:msfadmin)

fullDescription.text: The OpenSSH service on port 22 accepts default credentials 'msfadmin:msfadmin', granting an interactive shell as standard user uid=1000(msfadmin). Separate local privilege escalation is required for root access.

help.text:
Immediate: Rotate the `msfadmin` password immediately (`passwd msfadmin`) and terminate active unauthorized SSH sessions.
Short-Term: Configure `/etc/ssh/sshd_config` with `PasswordAuthentication no`, `PermitRootLogin no`, and `MaxAuthTries 3`, then reload `sshd`.
Verification: Verify `ssh msfadmin@192.168.195.139` rejects password authentication (`Permission denied (publickey)`).

shortDescription.text: Local Privilege Escalation Vector: SUID Binary (/usr/bin/nmap)

fullDescription.text: Post-authentication enumeration over SSH identified /usr/bin/nmap with the setuid-root bit enabled. Legacy Nmap versions (2.02–5.21) support '--interactive' mode, allowing an authenticated local user (msfadmin, uid=1000) to spawn a root shell (!sh).

help.text:
Immediate: Remove the SUID-root bit from `/usr/bin/nmap` immediately (`chmod u-s /usr/bin/nmap`) and audit all SUID binaries via `find / -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null`.
Short-Term: Upgrade Nmap to a modern release (>= 7.9x) that removes `--interactive` shell escapes and enforce `nosuid` mount options on `/tmp` and `/home`.
Verification: Run `ls -la /usr/bin/nmap` and confirm permissions read `-rwxr-xr-x` without the `s` flag, and `nmap --interactive` is unavailable. [Target Endpoint: `192.168.195.139:22`]
